page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r9i.12xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance configured on the KVM hypervisor. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at a base clock speed of 3.2 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU core.

This instance does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. It also lacks hardware acceleration, featuring zero GPUs. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 25 Gbps. It does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 1:8 makes this instance profile suitable for memory-intensive workloads without the overhead of paying for unneeded local storage or GPU hardware. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities. Appropriate workloads for this configuration include in-memory databases, large-scale caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-heavy data processing applications.
